<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Visa Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Austrian Representation Office (BMEIA)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Visa decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_DecisionReceived" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria - Applicant" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Need to work and live in Austria"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check visa requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check the requirements for working and living in Austria, including the general principles and requirements for the issue of visas.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" name="Organize accommodation and bank account">
      <bpmn:documentation>Negotiate accommodation and bank account.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DocsMerge" name="Application documents needed"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocsSplit" name="Prepare visa documents"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckTravelDocument" name="Provide travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Travel document valid in Austria, with validity exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months, with at least two empty pages, and issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Passport photo in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_HealthInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Means" name="Provide proof of means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_DocsJoin" name="Visa documents prepared"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddlSplit" name="Additional documents requested?" default="Flow_AddlNo"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AdditionalEvidence" name="Provide additional evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, for example hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. The evidence may vary depending on location.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddlMerge" name="Evidence complete"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineRepresentation" name="Determine competent representation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schengen visas are applied for at the representation office of the country of the main travel destination; if no main destination can be determined, at the country of first entry. Category A and C visas are applied for in the consular district of legal place of residence, with possible exceptional competence. Type D visas are applied for at the competent Austrian representation, based on place of residence under Section 8 FPG. A list of representation offices is provided by the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Submit" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visas are issued by representation offices abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, by the state police headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DecisionReceived" name="Visa decision received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Visa granted?" default="Flow_Refused">
      <bpmn:documentation>Absence of other grounds for refusal (residence prohibition, alert issued by a Schengen country) is a condition of the decision.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Refused" name="Application refused"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RenewalTimer" name="Renewal period reached">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visa is renewed every x months.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" name="Renewal required?" default="Flow_NoRenewal"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareRenewal" name="Prepare visa renewal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare renewal of the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StayConcluded" name="Stay concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_OrganizeAccommodation" targetRef="Gateway_DocsMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Task_HealthInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsSplit" targetRef="Task_Means"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_DocsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CheckTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_DocsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_DocsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_HealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_DocsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_Means" targetRef="Gateway_DocsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_DocsJoin" targetRef="Gateway_AddlSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddlSplit" targetRef="Task_AdditionalEvidence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddlNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddlSplit" targetRef="Gateway_AddlMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalEvidence" targetRef="Gateway_AddlMerge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Granted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Event_RenewalTimer">

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Main">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Visa Applicant">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReqSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideTravelDoc</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PassportPhoto</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HealthInsurance</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Means</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ReqJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DetermineRepresentation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AdditionalEvidence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_RenewalTimer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RenewalNeeded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PrepareRenewal</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_StayConcluded</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Representation" name="Austrian Representation Office (BMEIA)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_VerifyTravelDoc</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckGrounds</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Review</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AddlSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Decision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_Refused</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Need to work and live in Austria"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check visa requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check the requirements for working and living in Austria, including the general principles and requirements for the issue of visas, and contact the representation in advance for further information.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Negotiate" name="Negotiate accommodation and bank account">
      <bpmn:documentation>Organize accommodation and bank account through negotiation.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrepMerge" name="Start visa preparation"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReqSplit" name="Prepare visa requirements"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete visa application form"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideTravelDoc" name="Provide travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months, with at least two empty pages, and issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Passport photo in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HealthInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay, with cover of 30,000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Means" name="Provide proof of means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_VerifyTravelDoc" name="Verify travel document validity">
      <bpmn:documentation>Representation office checks that the travel document meets the validity period, empty page and issue date requirements.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckGrounds" name="Check absence of other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check for other grounds for refusal: residence prohibition and alert issued by a Schengen country.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ReqJoin" name="Visa requirements met"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DetermineRepresentation" name="Determine competent representation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schengen visas are applied for at the representation office of the country of the main travel destination; if no main destination can be determined, at the representation of the country of first entry into the Schengen area. Category A and C visas are applied for at the representation in the consular district of legal place of residence, with possible exceptional competence. Type D visas are applied for at the competent Austrian representation, based on place of residence under Section 8 FPG. A list of representation offices is provided on the website of the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Submit" name="Submit visa application">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visas are issued by representation offices abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, by the state police headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_Review" name="Review visa application">
      <bpmn:documentation>Representation office reviews the submitted application and items; additional documents may be requested depending on circumstances.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AddlSplit" name="Additional documents requested?" default="Flow_AddlNo"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AdditionalEvidence" name="Provide additional evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, for example hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. The evidence may vary depending on location and is coordinated with other Schengen representations.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Visa granted?" default="Flow_Refused"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Refused" name="Application refused"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RenewalTimer" name="Renewal period reached">
      <bpmn:documentation>The visa is valid for a limited number of months and is renewed every x months.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" name="Renewal required?" default="Flow_NoRenewal"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PrepareRenewal" name="Prepare visa renewal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare renewal of the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StayConcluded" name="Stay concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_ReqSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideTravelDoc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_ReqSplit" targetRef="Task_PassportPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_ReqSplit" targetRef="Task_HealthInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_ReqSplit" targetRef="Task_Means"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_ReqSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTravelDoc" targetRef="Task_VerifyTravelDoc"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_ReqJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_VerifyTravelDoc" targetRef="Gateway_ReqJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_PassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_ReqJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_HealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_ReqJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_Means" targetRef="Gateway_ReqJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_CheckGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_ReqJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Gateway_ReqJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_DetermineRepresentation" targetRef="Task_Submit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_Submit" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_Review" targetRef="Gateway_AddlSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddlYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AddlSplit" targetRef="Task_AdditionalEvidence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AddlNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AddlSplit" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_AdditionalEvidence" targetRef="Task_Review"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Granted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Event_RenewalTimer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visaGranted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refused" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Event_RenewalTimer" targetRef="Gateway_RenewalNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RenewalYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" targetRef="Task_PrepareRenewal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${renewalRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRenewal" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" targetRef="EndEvent_StayConcluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_PrepareRenewal" targetRef="Gateway_PrepMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkLiveAustria" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/work-live-austria">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkLiveAustria" name="Work and Live in Austria">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Applicant" name="Visa Applicant" processRef="Process_Applicant"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Representation" name="Austrian Representation Office (BMEIA)"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Application" name="Visa application" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Participant_Representation" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReviewResult" name="Application reviewed" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_ReviewResult" messageRef="Message_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Visa decision" sourceRef="Participant_Representation" targetRef="Event_DecisionReceived" messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaApplication" name="Visa application"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReviewResult" name="Application reviewed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_VisaDecision" name="Visa decision"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Applicant" name="Work and Live in Austria - Applicant" isExecutable="false">

    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Need to work and live in Austria"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Negotiate" name="Negotiate accommodation and bank account">
      <bpmn:documentation>Organize accommodation and bank account through negotiation.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckRequirements" name="Check visa requirements">
      <bpmn:documentation>Check the requirements for working and living in Austria, including the general principles and requirements for the issue of visas.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsMerge" name="Requirements check needed"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" name="Prepare visa requirements"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteForm" name="Complete visa application form">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visa application form.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideTravelDocument" name="Provide travel document">
      <bpmn:documentation>Travel document valid in Austria, with a validity period exceeding the duration of the visa by at least three months, with at least two empty pages, issued within the last ten years.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto" name="Provide passport photo">
      <bpmn:documentation>Passport photo in portrait format, 35 x 45 mm, in accordance with the specified passport photo criteria.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance" name="Provide travel health insurance">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fully comprehensive travel health insurance policy for the planned duration of the stay, amount of cover 30,000 Euro, valid for the entire Schengen area.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideMeans" name="Provide proof of means of subsistence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Proof of sufficient means of subsistence for the duration of the intended stay and for the return journey to the country of origin or residence.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_CheckNoRefusalGrounds" name="Check absence of other grounds for refusal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Absence of other grounds for refusal, such as a residence prohibition or an alert issued by a Schengen country, is checked by the authorities.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" name="Requirements provided"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineRepresentation" name="Determine competent representation">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schengen visas are applied for at the representation office of the country of the main travel destination; if no main destination can be determined, at the country of first entry. Category A and C visas are applied for in the consular district of the legal place of residence, with possible exceptional competence. Type D visas are applied for at the competent Austrian representation, based on place of residence under Section 8 FPG. A list of representation offices is available from the Federal Ministry of European and International Affairs.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SubmitApplication" name="Submit visa application" messageRef="Message_VisaApplication">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visas are issued by representation offices abroad or, in specific exceptional cases, by certain border control posts or, where extension is permitted, by the state police headquarters.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReviewResult" name="Application reviewed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_ReviewResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_FurtherEvidence" name="Additional documents requested?" default="Flow_NoAdditionalEvidence"/>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideAdditionalEvidence" name="Provide additional evidence">
      <bpmn:documentation>Other evidence requested by the relevant authorities, for example hotel reservations, invitations, booking confirmations, return flight ticket or proof of gainful employment. The evidence may vary depending on location.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DecisionReceived" name="Visa decision received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_VisaDecision"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Decision" name="Visa granted?" default="Flow_Refused"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Refused" name="Application refused"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_RenewalTimer" name="Renewal period reached">
      <bpmn:documentation>Visa is renewed every x months.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" name="Renewal required?" default="Flow_NoRenewal"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareRenewal" name="Prepare visa renewal">
      <bpmn:documentation>Prepare renewal of the Rot-Weiss-Rot Card visa.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StayConcluded" name="Stay concluded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_Negotiate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_Negotiate" targetRef="Task_CheckRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_CheckRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsMerge" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CompleteForm"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideTravelDocument"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_ProvideMeans"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckNoRefusalGrounds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CompleteForm" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTravelDocument" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePassportPhoto" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_ProvideHealthInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_ProvideMeans" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_CheckNoRefusalGrounds" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Gateway_RequirementsJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineRepresentation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_DetermineRepresentation" targetRef="Task_SubmitApplication"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_SubmitApplication" targetRef="Event_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Event_ReviewResult" targetRef="Gateway_FurtherEvidence"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalEvidence" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_FurtherEvidence" targetRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalEvidence">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${additionalDocumentsRequested}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalEvidence" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_FurtherEvidence" targetRef="Event_DecisionReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_ProvideAdditionalEvidence" targetRef="Event_ReviewResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Event_DecisionReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Granted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="Event_RenewalTimer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${visaGranted}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refused" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Decision" targetRef="EndEvent_Refused"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Event_RenewalTimer" targetRef="Gateway_RenewalNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RenewalYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" targetRef="Task_PrepareRenewal">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${renewalRequired}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoRenewal" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RenewalNeeded" targetRef="EndEvent_StayConcluded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_PrepareRenewal" targetRef="Gateway_RequirementsMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
